Mr. Roy Bruckner, Rosedale Project Manager made staff presentation.
Mr. Robert Trapp representing Azusa Land Partners stated the Design Review has been approved and actual construction depends on the economy picking up.
Mr. Daniel Nephart, spoke.
Ms. Corina Mongilla, spoke.
Mr. Robert Trapp, stated the Fire Station would be constructed next to existing site and the money to construct is Azusa Land Partners’.
Commissioner Rosales moved to approve 1. Case No.: Extension of Time EXT 2009-01 Applicant: Azusa Land Partners
